sentiment.rationale: The company reported a solid quarter with organic net revenue growth of 3.3% and beer volume growth of 0.7%, but full-year guidance was only reaffirmed, not raised. Management language is confident but hedged, noting 'some markets navigating challenging consumer and industry trends' and a 'subdued consumer environment' in Europe. The forward outlook is unchanged, so the score is neutral.

summary.revenue: Revenue €9,072 million for the quarter, €26,895 million year to date. Net revenue (beia) organic growth 3.3% for the quarter, 5.1% year to date.
summary.guidance: 2024 full year expectations of 4% to 8% operating profit (beia) organic growth confirmed and reiterated.
key_risks: Currency translation reduced net revenue (beia) by €471 million in the quarter, mainly from devaluation of Nigerian Naira, Mexican Peso, Brazilian Real, and Ethiopian Birr.
Subdued consumer environment in Europe, with on-premise channel declines.
Softer industry trends in Mexico and USA.
Strong beer market decline in Cambodia.
Persisting security issues in Haiti leading to volume decline.
Inflation-led pricing to compensate for currency devaluations in Africa & Middle East.
Calculated negative translational impact for full year of approximately €1,570 million in net revenue (beia).
key_opportunities: Premium beer volume organic growth 4.5% for the quarter, led by Heineken® up 8.7%.
Heineken® Silver grew in the high-twenties, with strong growth in China and Vietnam.
eB2B platforms captured €9.3 billion in gross merchandise value year to date, up 26% organically.
Growth in Europe and Africa & Middle East more than compensating for declines in Americas and Asia Pacific.
Nigeria: organic net revenue (beia) grew in the seventies, with beer volume up high-twenties.
South Africa: beer volume grew low-twenties, with multi-category growth.
India: premium volume grew in the thirties, led by Heineken® Silver and Kingfisher Ultra.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO stated 'We delivered a solid quarter of balanced growth' and 'We confirm and reiterate our full year outlook... reflecting our confidence in delivery and commitment to invest behind growth.'

evidence.claim: Revenue for the quarter was €9,072 million and year-to-date €26,895 million.
evidence.quote: Revenue €9,072 million for the quarter, €26,895 million year to date

evidence.claim: Net revenue (beia) organic growth was 3.3% for the quarter and 5.1% year to date.
evidence.quote: Net revenue (beia) organic growth 3.3% for the quarter, 5.1% year to date

evidence.claim: Full-year guidance for operating profit (beia) organic growth of 4% to 8% was confirmed and reiterated.
evidence.quote: 2024 full year expectations of 4% to 8% operating profit (beia) organic growth confirmed and reiterated

evidence.claim: Currency translation reduced net revenue (beia) by €471 million in the quarter.
evidence.quote: Currency translation reduced net revenue (beia) by €471 million (YTD: €1,097 million), mainly from the devaluation of the Nigerian Naira, Mexican Peso, Brazilian Real, and Ethiopian Birr.

evidence.claim: Europe is experiencing a subdued consumer environment.
evidence.quote: In a subdued consumer environment, we are restoring our competitiveness by increasing investment behind our brands and balancing moderate pricing with consumer affordability.

evidence.claim: Mexico and USA are experiencing softer industry trends.
evidence.quote: Growth in Brazil partly offset declines in Mexico and the USA, markets which are experiencing softer industry trends.

evidence.claim: Cambodia experienced a strong beer market decline.
evidence.quote: Despite encouraging progress in our largest markets, the quarter was impacted by a strong beer market decline in Cambodia.

evidence.claim: Haiti volume declined due to persisting security issues.
evidence.quote: In Haiti volume declined in the mid-teens due to persisting security issues.

evidence.claim: Premium beer volume grew 4.5% in the quarter.
evidence.quote: Premium beer volume organic growth 4.5% for the quarter, 4.9% year to date

evidence.claim: Heineken® volume grew 8.7% in the quarter.
evidence.quote: Heineken® volume growth 8.7% for the quarter, 9.0% year to date
Non-alcoholic beer & cider grew 11.0% as we further reinforced global leadership in the segment.

evidence.claim: eB2B platforms captured €9.3 billion in gross merchandise value year to date, up 26% organically.
evidence.quote: In our business-to-business digital (eB2B) platforms, we captured €9.3 billion in gross merchandise value year to date, an organic increase of 26% versus last year.

evidence.claim: Nigeria saw strong growth with organic net revenue (beia) growing in the seventies.
evidence.quote: In Nigeria, organic net revenue (beia) grew in the seventies, delivering consolidated volume growth in the high-teens with pricing to mitigate significant inflation and the devaluation of the Nigerian Naira.

evidence.claim: South Africa beer volume grew low-twenties.
evidence.quote: Beer volume grew in the low-twenties, led by Heineken®, Windhoek, and Amstel and we built momentum behind our multi-category business model delivering growth in all categories.

evidence.claim: India premium volume grew in the thirties.
evidence.quote: Premium volume grew in the thirties, led by Heineken® Silver, Kingfisher Ultra, and Kingfisher Ultra Max.

We delivered a solid quarter of balanced growth... We confirm and reiterate our full year outlook to grow operating profit (beia) organically in the range of 4% to 8%, reflecting our confidence in delivery and commitment to invest behind growth and to future-proof our business.

evidence.claim: Calculated negative translational impact for full year is approximately €1,570 million in net revenue (beia).
evidence.quote: Based on the impact to date, and applying spot rates of 21 October 2024 to the 2023 financial results as a baseline for the remainder of the year, the calculated negative translational impact for the full year would be approximately €1,570 million in net revenue (beia), €220 million at consolidated operating profit (beia), and €50 million at net profit (beia).

review_flags.reason: Guidance was reaffirmed, not raised, and there are mixed regional trends; score of 0.0 reflects neutral forward expectations, but reviewer may consider whether the reaffirmation plus strong premium growth warrants a slightly positive score.
